    def test_codec_concatenates_single_tool_call_arguments_across_chunks() -> None:
        asm = SSEChunkAssembler()
        chunks = [
            {"choices": [{"delta": {"tool_calls": [{"index": 0, "id": "call_abc", "function": {"name": "read_file", "arguments": '{"path": '}}]}}]},
